text:
Rae (PM): Quick design sync on a compact 'quick actions' pattern for the API keys list. Goal: let users rotate/disable/copy with minimal friction. Mock: https://figma.com/s/quick-actions-keys
Jun (design): Thinking a single kebab on each row that expands an inline mini-panel (not a modal). Panel contains primary CTAs + small 'details' link that opens the full drawer.
Asha (eng): Backend note: rotate must still produce a single-show secret. Inline rotate should open a tiny ephemeral panel showing the new secret and a Download CTA. No full page nav.
Lina (a11y): A11y checklist: expansion must set focus to the first button, announce "Actions opened for <key-name>" via aria-live, and restore focus when panel closes.
Rae (PM): Copy ideas for the inline disable: label = "Disable (temporarily)" tooltip: "Prevents new auths; existing tokens remain valid until revoked." Full revoke remains in drawer.
Jun (design): Visual: use amber for Disable, red for Revoke. Also a subtle 'last used' line in the mini-panel and a masked last IP hint to help decisions.
Asha (eng): Implementation ask: expose an 'undo' for Disable for 120s. Also only show the copy secret action immediately after rotate; otherwise hide it.
Lina (a11y): Toasts must use role="status". When secret is revealed, ensure screen readers do not keep it in the accessibility tree after hide. Mask toggle should have aria-pressed and live label updates.
Rae (PM): Empty state wording proposal: "No API keys yet. Create one to start integrating Redwood. Use a dev key (read-only) for testing)" CTA: "Create API key" with focus on load.
Jun (design): Microcopy tweak for create modal: header "Create API key" body: "Secret shown once 12 download or store in your vault." Primary CTA: "Download secret" secondary: "Copy & close".
Asha (eng): Edge: if someone disables a key with active sessions, show inline warning: "Active connections may be affected depending on client caching." Provide link to docs.
infra-bot: deploy:preview #keys-quick-actions succeeded -> https://preview.redwood.ai/keys-quick-actions
Lina (a11y): Final note: ensure keyboard users can open/close mini-panel with Enter and Escape, and that the 'details' link is reachable via Tab inside panel.
Rae (PM): Thanks. I'll update the figma and push the prototype to dev for an a11y pass. If no objections we'll ship behind a feature flag next sprint. :rocket:
